newsitem.title: USA: British Airways plans to keep USAir stake - report.
newsitem.headline: British Airways plans to keep USAir stake - report.

text.p: British Airways had no intention of divesting its holdings in USAir, the company's chief executive told the Washington Post in an interview published on Thursday.

Robert Ayling, in the United States for a one-day meeting of the USAir board, said he used the occasion to inform members that British Airways "was a major investor in USAir, remains a major investor in USAir and intends to remain a major investor in USAir."
British Air owns 24.6 percent of USAir, shares it purchased in 1993 as part of a financial bailout of the troubled U.S. carrier.
USAir is trying to sever ties with British Airways because of the latter's recently proposed alliance with American Airlines.
Ayling told the Post he wanted USAir to be part of the marketing alliance that British Airways and American Airlines wanted to form, but declined to specify what role USAir might play.
